tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring du bya ba yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha rat+na war+dhā ya/ kun khyab thabs la mkhas pa'i snying rje dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal shes rab che// dbyer med dges pa rdo rje la btud de// rgyal ba rigs drug sgrub thabs bshad kyis nyon// 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su nub mo chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs lha sku bde ba chen po'i nga rgyal gyis langs/ bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la/ bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas kha shar phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsan rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsams/

sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/

rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyong*/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me/ las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ sems la dge legs su ni mdzod/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung du/ mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ bdag grol khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis dpal kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/

thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba/ de yang rang rig sgyu ma lta bu/ de yang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du shes par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba go skabs med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūm̐ ser po/ phyogs bcur nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/

gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de thams cad so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad phyag g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams brjid pa'i khro bo ste/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ sku sbom zhing thung ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ khro bo gzhan rnams ni mdzes pa'i khro bo ste/ cung zad sgeg cing yid tsam khros pa/ sku skems shing grim pa/ dbu skra nag po/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu gcig srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ khu tshur g.yon gyi mthe'u chung dang g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbrel te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pas srung 'khor gyi nang du spyan drangs/ khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad de zhags mig ltar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pas mgrin pa la reg pas ye shes pa rnams smin mtshams nas thim/ mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo phan tshun sbrel te/ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī ban+dha baṃ/ zhes be tā lī ser mo lcags sgrog thogs pas zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'dres/ khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes ghasma rī ljang gu dril bu thogs pas phyi nang kun tu dril bu'i sgra phyung bas/ dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ bsdu na/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// zhes pas mchod/

bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje'i gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pas gtams par bsam/ hūm̐ de nyid rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa cig tu gyur te/ de'i lte ba stong par yod pa'i nang du rang gi sems hūm̐ gcig tu bsam/ de'i steng la sogs par gang bsrung bar 'dod pa de'i ming gi yi ge dang po bsams te/ de yang bla ma bsrung bar 'dod na steng du/ rang nyid nang du/ spun zla g.yon du/ pha ma mdun du/ bu dang chung ma g.yas su/ 'khor g.yog rgyab tu/ nor rdzas rnams 'og tu bsam/ gang mi bsrung ba'i sa stong par bzhag go /de nas 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs med pa'i bar du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gnod byed lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyug pa/ spyi'u tshugs su 'dug par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gnod byed kyi shes pa bkug ste de la thim par bsams la/ rang gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs/ dbus dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang*/ 'khor lo g.yon du myur du 'khor bas/

gnod byed kyi lus rlung gis bskyod/ mes bsreg cing 'khor lo'i rtse mos gtubs pas/ kho'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas/ rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsams shing sngags bzla'o// na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas sangs rgyas la/ na maḥs man+ta dharmā ṇāṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas chos la/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas dge 'dun la/ oṃ si tā ta pa tra/ gdugs dkar po/ oṃ bi ma la/ dri ma dang bral ba/ oṃ shaṅka ra/ bde bar byed pa/ oṃ pra t+yaṃ gir/ phyir bzlog pa/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra warti/ rdo rje gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ sarba yan+t+ra/ thams cad 'khrul 'khor/ man+t+ra/ sngags/ mū la karma/ rtsa ba'i las/ ban+dha naṃ/ bcings pa dang*/ tā ḍa naṃ/ brdeg pa dang*/ kī la nāṃ wā/ phur bu btab kyang rung*/ ma ma kṛ te/ bdag la byed ba dang*/ ye na ken tsi ta/ gang ci yang rung ba/ kṛ tan+ta ta/ byed ma de/ sarbān+tu/ thams cad/ ts+tshin+dats+tshin+da/ chod chod/ bhin+da bhin+da/ phug phug tsi ri tsi ri/ phye mar gyis phye mar gyis/ gi ri gi ri/ gnon gnon/ ma ra ma ra/ sod sod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces ci nus dang*/ spro na/ oṃ bha ya nā sa ni/ 'jigs pa nyams par byed/ trā sa ni/ skrag par byed/ sarba mā ra pra t+yaṃ gir/ bdud thams cad phyir zlog par byed/ bi nā sa ni/ rnam par nyams par byed/ yi ge tsi ta/ gang ci yang rung ba/ duṣ+ṭān satwa/ gdug pa'i sems can/ ma ma bi rū pa kaṃ kurban/ bdag la ngan pa byed pa/ ti tā ni/ de dag dang*/ sarba mā ra ṇi pra t+yaṃ kā ri ṇi pa ta tu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bdud thams cad kyi phyir bzlog par gyis shig

zhes pa'ang ci rigs bzlas la/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o// ngag bcing bar bgyi'o// yid bcing bar bgyi'o// mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ces brjod cing lag mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje dang sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par bsams te/ gnod byed rnams de'i bar du btsir bar bsams la thal mo brdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa du ma spros te gnod byed kyi lus dang dbang po thams cad rdul phra rab tu byas/ mes bsreg rlung gis gtor bar bsam/ spro na/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// zhes brjod/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba zhu ba las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu/ chang zung dang mchog ma la yam̐ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/

de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang lte ba la lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa de rnams 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim ste/ thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga g.yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'bar ba'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu dgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu 'jigs byed mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki la'i sgra sgrog pa/

de dag la gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shar du shi rī sha/ lhor tsu ta/ nub tu kaṃ ka la/ byang du a shwat+tha/ byang shar du shing chen po/ shar lhor ka rañdza/ lho nub tu 'khril shing can/ nub byang du ardzun rnams so// shing de dag gi rtsa ba na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ phyag g.yon na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dbyu gu dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis na spyi blugs dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa g.yon thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags la zhon pa g.yon thod pa dang ba dan 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yas kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'o// de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad ni/ shar du sgrogs byed ser po/ lhor ldog byed sngon po/ nub tu 'jigs byed dkar po/ byang du 'khor byed ser po/ byang shar du 'thug po dkar po/ shar lhor 'gengs byed dmar po/ lho nub tu char 'bebs sngon po/ nub byang du gtum po sngon po'o// de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas ser po/ lhor pad+ma dkar po/ nub tu karko ṭa nag po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po dkar po/ shar lhor hu lun+ta sngon po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang gu/ nub byang du dung skyong ser po thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/

stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'o// shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong pa can/ nub tu sprin gyi rgyal po dmar po chu srin gyi gdong pa can/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta'i gdong pa can/ byang shar du yi dwags 'dus pa dud ka glang gi gdong pa can/ shar lhor drang srong 'dus pa dmar po ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ lho nub tu srin po'i tshogs can nag po ro langs kyi gdong pa can/ nub byang du rlung gi rgyal po ljang gu ri dwags kyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang shing lo'i gseb nas snying ga yan chad 'thon pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o// gzhan yang ro mgo bo bcad pa dang*/ dpyangs pa dang*/ bsnyal ba dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ keng rus dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ ro langs rnams phaiṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs par byed pa/ ma lus pa rnams kyang sngon gyi grub pa thob pa rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa ste/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngon po'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo/ tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/

byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thags zangs ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ta ni la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i g.yon du am̐ las gri gug sngo nag yu ba la am̐ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/

g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje ngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dhā ra/

pad+ma bde ba 'dzin pa ni/ mahā rā ga su khan+da da/ 'dod chags chen po'i bde ba ster/ tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa/ dga' bzhi'i skal ba sna tshogs pa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ bya ba mdzod cig bdag la'o// yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa/ rdo rje zhe sdang chen po ni/ tsa tu rā nan+da dā ya kaḥ dga' ba bzhi ni ster bar byed/ kha ga mu kha e kā ra so nā tha/ mkha' 'gro'i gdong pa ro gcig mgon/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ bya ba mdzod cig bdag la'o// yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si kun dur+ha badz+ra dh+rika ces gsang ba'i gnas su grag pa'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pas thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu lha mo brgyad du gyur nas/ yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'thon te/ gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu be tā lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge/ g.yon dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/

g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bar snang nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar yi ges slebs pa'i rkyen gyi yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi shes pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhir 'phos te glus bskul bar bsams shing*/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// kyai yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyi// mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas/ thig le de nyid hūm̐ dang am̐ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/

g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal ka/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje ngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ de rnams las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog gzhal yas khang dang*/

bcud kyi sems can la phog lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ thams cad kyi mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar dam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar pam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying khar nam̐ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ spro na/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// zhes pas bstod/ khu tshur g.yon gyi mthe'u chung dang g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbrel te/

oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pas srung 'khor gyi nang du spyan drangs/ khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad de zhags mig ltar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pas mgrin par reg pas ye shes pa rnams smin mtshams nas thim/ mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo phan tshun sbrel te/ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī ban+dha baṃ/ zhes dang*/ be tā lī ser mo lcags sgrog thogs pas zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'dres/ khu tshur bcangs pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes dang*/ ghasma rī ljang gu dril bu thogs pas phyi nang kun tu dril bu'i sgra byung bas/ dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam// ༈ /zab mo lus dkyil ni/ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gi rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ sen mo me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshig ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re khā/ sna rin po che'i pha gu/ so drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba'i ām̐/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i hā/ phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das phrin las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba'i hūm̐/ zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba'i oṃ/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i ham̐/

gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes gtso bo lnga po thams cad dbu'i gtsug tor blta bar mi mngon pa la sogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs pa dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ gzhan yang mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de dag gi mdun du zhal nang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis mig tu gzugs gau rī/ rna bar sgra tsau rī/ snar dri be tā lī/ lcer ro ghasma rī/ dpral bar reg sa spyod ma/ snying gar chos khams mkha' spyod ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon par shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ lcer pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/

g.yon par stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha de thams cad kyang sku dbyibs/ rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin stong gsal/ ngo bo zung 'jug gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// zhes dang*/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// yid dang phrag dog chen po kun// rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa// rdo rje can kun bdag dges mdzod// dbang lha'i mdun du pad zla'i gdan la dbang rdzas rnams kyang yod par bsam/ cho ga rnams bla mas mdzad cing*/ dbang rdzas rnams de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i he ru ka zhig gis gtod par bsam mo// oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/

oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/

pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ ām̐ las rin po che ām̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i ām̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa/ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥ zhes gsung zhing cod pan bcings te/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/

sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbur brgyan/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// zhes bstod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// lan gsum/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcing bar bsam/ bla ma he ru ka lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thig le bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ thig le mgrin pa nas 'phel te lus thams cad gang bas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye bar bsam/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// zhes bstod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcing bar bsam/ bla mas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// zhes gsung zhing phyag rgya ma zhig bdag la gtad de/

des bdag la/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro 'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par// bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes 'dri ba la/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par cis mi spro// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par// bdag nyid ci gar spro gyur to// zhes lan btab pas phyag rgya des/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na bdag 'dug ste// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// s+t+waṃ pad+ma bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsung zhing bdag gi pang du byon par gyur/ rig ma bdag med mar gsal ba'i mkha' āḥlas pad+ma āḥs mtshan pa dang rang nyid kye rdo rje lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas par gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes spyi bo'i ham̐ bzhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ mkha' gsang gi rtser byang sems dkar dmar 'dzoms pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slar rlung gi nus pas byang sems yar drangs te/ lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par byon pas dga' bral/ spyi bor byon pas lhan skyes mngon du byas par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag

maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang*// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcing bar bsam/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes gsungs par bsams te/ de'i don/ rang nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul sku/ sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde chen gyi rnam par shar ba longs sku/ lha sku bde chen gyi rnam par snang tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba chos sku/ de gsum ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ mdor na sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa/ gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal lha skur 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la 'dzin med du bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rdo rje rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/

ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang yongs su rdzogs par thog pa'i gtang rag tu dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyi slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// lan gsum/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang shā wa rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍoṃ bi nī la 'od dpag med/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bdud rtsi dngos su 'byor ram bsams kyang rung ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ sha de rnams re'i steng du yang*/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/

lhor ām̐ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du kham̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor ām̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon skor gyis a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ g.yas skor gyis ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa hak+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas/ oṃ dang rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te myangs la/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas bde bas tshim par bsams te/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams shing*/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsams la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes de yan chad rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bsgoms la/ rten dang brten pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu la sems gzung*/ de la brtan pa na rdzogs pa'i rim pa bla ma las ji ltar thob pa ltar nyams su blang ngo*// zhes gsungs pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i gtum mo'i rnal 'byor bsten pa'i phyir/ lte bar zhes sogs smos te/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bsgoms pa'i lus kyi dbus su/ spyi gtsug nas lte ba'i bar rtsa a ba dhū tī shin tu phra zhing gsal ba thig le dwangs mas gang ba/ de'i g.yas su ro ma me'i rang bzhin rak+tas gang ba dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dkar po ste/ rtsa gsum gsal btab/ de nas a ba dhū tī la bsten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lte bar am̐ dmar po me'i rang bzhin mgo gyen la blta ba/

nang skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha/ phy-i 'dab ma la ā li phrag gnyis/ kā li phrag gcig la ha dang k+ṣa spangs pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po mgo thur du blta ba/ phyogs bzhir/ bh+rūm̐ am̐ dz+rim̐ kham̐/ mtshams bzhir/ lam̐ mam̐ pām̐ tām̐/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar po mgo gyen du blta ba/ 'dab ma la ā li phrag gcig spyi bor bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar ham̐ dkar po mgo mthur du blta ba/ 'dab ma la ā li phrag gnyis bsam/ bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sum mdor me'i dkyil 'khor yang bsgoms nas/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzums kyi sbyor ba byas pas 'og gi rlung lte bar gtum mo'i ngo bo am̐ yig la phog pas/ de me sbar ba'i sbyor ba yis g.yas ro ma'i me dang 'grogs te gyen du 'bar bas snying gar de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bo yig 'bru lnga bsregs te yang yar 'bar bas/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo spyan ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhi'i ngo bo yig 'bru bzhi yang bsregs pa'i rjes su me des spyi bo'i 'khor lo bsregs pas/ de'i dbus kyi ham̐ de las ri bong can byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun g.yon rkyang ma'i byang sems dang bsdongs nas rim gyis 'dzag pa ste 'bab pas mgrin pa dang snying ga'i 'khor lo rnams sngar bas kyang gsal bar gsos btab nas/ thigs pa gcig lte ba'i am̐ la phog pas/ am̐ las me'i zer shin tu phra ba a ba dhū tī'i nang nas myur du song bas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bcom spyi bo'i ham̐ la phog pas ham̐ las byang sems dwangs ma shin tu phra ba'i rgyun dbu ma'i lam nas 'dzag snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ gsal btab nas/ de'i nus pas lte ba'i me cher 'bar/ 'bar ba dang 'dzag pa dbu mar thim pas 'bar ba'i nus pas lus drod kyis gang zhing nad dang rtog pa bsregs/

'dzag pa'i stobs kyis rtsa sbubs thams cad thig les khengs nas bde bas lus rgyas/ sems la ye shes skyes par bsam zhing*/ rlung kha sbyor bsgom par bya'o// rgyun du bsgoms na drod 'bar zhing gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye la/ goms nas rang byung gi ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// ye shes des lha dang phyi rol gyi dngos po rnams la rgyas btab nas bsgoms pas/ bskyed rim gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dug sbyangs nas zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// 'dir ni bsgom bya'i ngo bo tsam zhig dang*/ gzhung gi 'bru 'joms pa tsam ste/ rgyas par ni grub chen ḍom+bhi pas mdzad pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung lhan cig skyes grub kyi bshad pa/ bla ma mkhas pa las nyan cing*/ don bsgoms pa las rtogs par 'gyur ro// zhes kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po'i gsung gnad kyi zla zer las zur du phyung pa'o// ༈ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ snying rje'i spyan mi dmar po la// byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid// de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum po// sha ni puk+ka sī ru brjod// de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma// gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// ces brjod/ rgyas pa la spro na/ glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo// khong skam mdze dang bir dzi ka /mchin pa mtsher pa'i nad rnams la// glang po la sogs rim shes bya// sa ni dang po nor 'dzin mthar// dbang phyug brgyad ni stsol bar mdzad// spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa// rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag

/lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod// ska rags la ni don yod gnas// yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon// bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gau rī ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ tsau rī ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ bai tā lī ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ ghasma rī ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ puk+ka sī ni byams pa tshad med pa/ sha wa rī ni snying rje tshad med pa/ gdol ba mo ni dga' ba tshad med pa/ g.yung mo ni btang snyoms tshad med pa/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa/ dur khrod brgyad ni sna bug gcig tu bsdams pa'i lus kyi bu ga rnam par dag pa'o// gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te// tshor ba la ni dkar mor bshad// 'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma// 'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni// bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so// sa ni puk+ka sī zhes brjod// chu khams rngon pa ma zhes brjod// me ni gtum mor shes par bya// rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags// zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma// 'dod chags chu yi rnal 'byor ma// phrag dog rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid// gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad// mig la gti mug rdo rje ma// rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma// sna la ser sna rdo rje ma// kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma// lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma// yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma// gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad// sgra la chom rkun mar rab grags// dri yi cha la ro langs ma// ro la ghasma rī rab grags// reg la sa spyod ma zhes brjod// chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma// zhes brjod cing don yid la dran par bya'o// dag pa dran pa 'di 'og spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi thog mar byas kyang nyes pa med do// ༈ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

dus rgyun du dkyil 'khor bsdus nas gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis byas kyang btub/ bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i tshe skabs 'di kho nar bya ste/ de yang*/ yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas 'thon yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs te rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba las/ las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas lha rnams dbang du 'dus par bsams la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/

rab bsngags brgyad pa'i zhal can la/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha warta ma ne/ dmar ser dbu skra gyen brdzes la/ tsa tu rbing+sha ti ne trā ya/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan ldan la/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ bcu drug pa yi phyag can la/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ char sprin ltar gnag sku can la/ ka pā la mā lā ni kā dhā ri ṇe/ thod phreng du ma 'dzin pa la/ adh+mā ta krū ra tsit+tā ya/ khong nas 'khrugs pa'i thugs can la/ ar+dhen+du daṃṣ+ṭ+rī ṇe/ zla phyed lta bu'i mche gtsigs la/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ gsod cig gsod cig kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gyis shig gyis shig gardza ya gardza ya/ sgrogs shig sgrags shig tardza ya tardza ya/ rtogs shig rtogs shig sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ skoms shig skoms shig sap+ta sā ga rā na/ mtsho bdun rnams/ ban+dha ban+dha chings shig chings shig nā gā ṣ+ṭa kān/ klu brgyad rnams/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ zung shig zung shig sha trūn/ dgra bo rnams/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ khos shig legs pa sbyin/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra lha 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra kartā ri rdo rje gri gug he badz+rā ya kye rdo rje/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying ngo*// oṃ āḥ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ li lī/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥnaṃ badz+ra ni rāt+mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje bdag med ma yi ched/ rnal 'byor ma rnams dang yum gyi'o// oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgam̐ badz+ra gau ri hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ badz+ra tsau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ badz+ra bai tā lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ āḥgham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgham̐ badz+ra ghasma rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥpam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥpam̐ badz+ra puk+ka sī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ badz+ra sha wa rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ badz+ra ḍoṃ bi nī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor gyi ste yab yum la ji tsam zlos pa'i bcu cha bzla/ yig brgya gsum mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ gong du dkyil 'khor ma bsdus na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad la/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la/ gzhal yas khang lha mo brgyad la/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim par bsams la/ tho rangs kyi thun ma yin pa'i thun gzhan gsum gyi rjes sam/ gtor ma dang 'brel na de'i rjes su/ kol+la'i ring gnas rdo rje dang*/ kol+la i reṭa ṭhi a bo lā/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ mum+mu nir gnas pad+ma'o// gha ṇe kṛ bi ṭa ho bādz+dza i/ kye ho tshogs su cang te'u dkrol/ ka ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ snying rjes ku co mi bya'o// ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza i/ de ru sha ni bza' bar bya/ gā ḍheṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza i/ 'bad pas chang ni btung bar bya/ ha le kā liñdza ra pa ṇi a i/ kye ho skal ldan gzhug par bya/ dun+du ra bādz+dzi a i/ skal med rnams ni spang bar bya/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu rī sih+lā/ bzhi nyam gla rtsi tu ruṣ+ka/

kāp+pu ra lā i a i/ ga bur rnams ni byug par bya/ mā la in+dha ṇa sā liñdza/ tshod ma dang ni sha chen po/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ der ni mang du bza' bar bya/ phreṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+te/ 'ong ba dang ni 'gro bar bya/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ṇi a i/ dag dang ma dag dmigs mi bya/ ni raṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ rus pa'i rgyan ni lus la gdags/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ der ni skyes pa'i ro gzhug bya/ ma la a dze kun du ru pā ṭa i/ 'du bar 'khrig la 'jug par bya/ ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta hin+na bādz+dzi a i/ der ni reg min spang mi bya/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin// zhes bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/ces smon lam btab/ rang nyid kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas srung ba byas la/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// lus can kun gyis bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du bsgrub nas tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can kun// bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar// skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po// rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang*// grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrin// rnam par dag cing rgyu gcig pa// bskal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te// thos nas gzhan la ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*// lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing*// bsgrub la bar chad med pa dang*// bstan la bya ba byed par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas// mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung*// bkra shis 'phel phyir rtag tu dran par 'gyur// pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid// yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos// he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des ni skye dgu bde legs shog

/sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ sogs dang*/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// sogs dang*/ tshangs dang brgya byin rgyal po chen po bzhi// rang rang sder bcas mthu dang dpal ldan pa// ston pa'i dam chos skyong bar mdzad pa yi// lha yi dge bsnyen rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab bcom nas// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan// sogs/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra shis shog /ces brjod// ༈ /spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis yul dang yul can thams cad lha'i 'khor lor shes par byas la sdang zhen med par longs spyad/ kha zas za ba'i tshe kha zas la lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bza' btung bdud rtsir bsams la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bor mchod par mos shing chags zhen med par bza'/ lhag ma/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ zhes se gol gyi sgra dang bcas te lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin/ khyim pa yin na 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor bya/ nyal ba'i tshe/ yum yab la/ yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la/ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ mthar nā da yang mi dmigs par bsams la 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i ngang du nyal/ tho rangs gnyid sad pa na chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis lha'i nga rgyal gyis langs la/ srod thun gyi rjes kyi rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis smon lam rnams bya/

khrus byed na dbang gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin nam/ rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis ngag tu yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bkrus la/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor logs nas 'byung ba ltar byas te tho rangs kyi thun la 'jug pa sogs gong bzhin du bya'o// ༈ /dbang 'bring po len na/ mchod bstod gsol btab byas mthar/ 'di de sangs rgyas dmas cad de// sogs nas/ 'bras bu sprul sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes gsung zhing rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs dam tshig gsum dang bcas par bskur bar bsams la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs nas/ dbang bskur ro// de ltar na rdzas gsang sogs nas/ longs sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag dga' ster gnas ster sogs nas/ mchod pa dag tu gyis/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i sogs nas/ chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag ye shes 'di ni sogs nas/ de yi pha zhes gsungs pas gong du smos pa lta bu'i dbang bzhi pa'i rtogs pa skyes par bsams la/ de ltar na don dam sogs nas/ ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag ces pa'i mthar/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des zhes sogs gong bzhin brjod do// ༈ /dbang bsdus pa ni/ gong gi ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥs dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bar sngar bzhin la/ de nas/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ sogs nas/ sa mā dzāḥ dkar mo ri dwags sogs mchod/ spro na/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// sogs nas/ bdag dges mdzod// ces bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa/ sogs nas/ dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sogs nas/ chen po sbyin/ oṃ badz+rī nas hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur/

rig ma rnams sogs nas/ chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ sogs nas/ yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ dbang gi chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo am̐ las kyi phyag rgya/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo hūm̐ chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo am̐ phyag rgya chen po/ spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo ham̐ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ dbang gi chu rgyun des snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ sogs nas/ ḍom+bhi nī la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba nas/ ko3haṃ/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs man sngar dang 'dra'o// de ltar na rnal 'byor rnam pa bcu bar ma chad par nyams su blangs na gnas skabs su grub mtha' rnams rim pas snyogs shing*/ mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// khams drug yul drug 'gro drug dbang po drug /kha dog drug dang phung po dbyings bcas drug /sbyangs nas rgyal ba rigs drug thob byed pa'i// sgrub thabs 'di ni yan lag drug pa yin// de yi ngag 'don mngon rtogs mdzes rgyan 'di// blo ldan slob ma mang pos bskul ba'i ngor// rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la gtugs te// 'dren mchog bla ma'i dgongs pa ji bzhin bkod// sngags rnams phal cher rgya dpe du ma la// gtugs te shin tu dag par bgyis pas na// ring thung gcod mtshams 'di bzhin shes gyis la// dpyod ldan rnams kyis dag par nyams su long*// bdag gis 'bad de legs par dpyad na yang*// zab don 'byed la byis blo mthu chung bas// nongs pa mchis na bla ma lhar bcas kyis// bzod pa mdzad de sdig kun sbyang du gsol// 'dir 'bad dge dang dge gzhan ci mchis des// 'dren mchog bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*// mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// bdag gis bla med byang chub myur thob shog

/dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring du bya ba yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po rat+na war+dha'i zhal snga nas dang*/ tshad med thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen dang*/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs chen po la sogs pa yongs 'dzin dam pa sprul pa'i sku du ma'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng rnyog pa med pa'i gtsug gis blangs pa la brten nas/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung rab rin po che rnams kyi tshig don la shes nas dad pa thob pa/ mang du thos pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis las dang po pa rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi yi ge la gzhi byas/ rje btsun gong ma yab sras kyi gsung rab rnams la zhus dag gi tshul du gtugs shing*/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung sgros kyis kyang brgyan te/ lcags mo phag gi lo ston zla 'bring po'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin/ rje bla ma yab sras gsum gyi dus dran gyi mchod par dmigs te/ dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba dge legs mchog tu gyur cig 'di'i rgyab rten du dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung rab rnams rtog dpyod zhib mos blta ba gal che'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
